test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 11 Jul, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. Select the option that contains an error.

Geeta was working now but she can be seen swimming in the river every evening.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3)**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the use of the word "**now**" with the past continuous tense "**was working**."
 
• The word "**now**" typically indicates present time, which is inconsistent with the past continuous tense.
 
• The correct phrase should be "**Geeta is working now**," ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **Option 3** of the sentence.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Geeta** is working now** but she can be seen swimming in the river every evening."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "but she can be seen"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 2: "swimming in the"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 4: "river every evening."** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
